selected.title: Burnaby Pride takes over Civic Square on Saturday

evidence.readerImpact: Burnaby residents can decide whether to attend the July 25 Pride festival and know the time, place, family-friendly format, and where to watch for final program details.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: The City of Burnaby and Burnaby Pride pages list the event for Saturday, July 25, 2026, two days after this sweep.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Existing Trends Today Burnaby things-to-do coverage includes art, library, stewardship, and park-event items, but no Pride festival bulletin.

selected.commercialFitReason: The official event pages show local event, family outing, arts, community, hospitality, transit, and retail intent; article-level views, ad viewability, RPM, revenue, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.

selected.title: Surrey says Newton park upgrades start this summer

evidence.readerImpact: Newton residents, athletes, families, and park users can see which amenities are planned at Newton Athletic Park and Unwin Park and when work is expected to begin.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: The City of Surrey published the park-upgrade announcement on July 22, 2026 and says construction begins this summer.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Existing Trends Today Surrey coverage includes heat, housing, and prior event notes, but not Newton Athletic Park or Unwin Park capital upgrades.

selected.commercialFitReason: The official Surrey notices create local intent around recreation, youth sport, active families, municipal facilities, accessibility, and neighbourhood planning; article-level views, ad viewability, RPM, revenue, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.
